title: data/labs.json
description: The labs whose published specs the index scores, one record per lab with the pinned spec it is verified against. lab ids are the join key for coverage records' lab_id.

items.description: Closed object: labs.json is the registry coverage records join against, so an undeclared key is a typo or an unreviewed field.

id.description: Stable slug used as lab_id in coverage records, e.g. anthropic.

spec_version.description: The pinned spec version coverage is verified against.

local_copy.description: Repo-relative path of the local spec copy under specs/.
